title: SCA Minhag of the Week 156: "Tefilla BeSibbur: First Half of Shabbat Minha"

chapters.title: Origins of the Uba L'Tzion Tune
chapters.about: Haham Meir Wachnin and Moroccan influence

chapters.title: VeAni Tefillati and Petihat Hechal
chapters.about: Singing VeAni Tefillati and opening the Hekhal

summary: Mr. Harari discusses the customs surrounding the Shabbat Minha prayer service within the Syrian community. He covers the timing of Minha Gedola and Minha Ketana, the use of the maqam Rast, and the origins of the community's traditional melodies for Uba L'Tzion and VeAni Tefillati.
questions: What is the difference between Minha Gedola and Minha Ketana?
What musical scale is used for Shabbat Minha?
Where does the community's tune for Uba L'Tzion originate?
Who is credited with introducing the Uba L'Tzion melody to the community?
How is VeAni Tefillati performed during the service?
